ambiguities_or_notes: The body heading's uncertain date, 18...20 November 1865, is preserved even though the catalog title gives 19 November 1865.

The post-emancipation land term «разверстание» is rendered as “land consolidation”: in this context it concerns the rearrangement/separation of intermingled landlord and peasant lands, not typographic page makeup or a generic financial apportionment.
Tolstoy's lowercase «архив» remains “the archive” in the body; the editorial note, rather than the translation, identifies it only probably as the journal Russian Archive.
